from pathlib import Path
p=Path('autotests/write/bw.rgb')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# Try a malformed but valid-looking RLE header with zero rows and nonzero zsize.
for off,val in [(4,1),(6,1),(8,1),(10,4)]:
    data[off:off+2]=val.to_bytes(2,'big')
# zero ysize to make _numrows zero but still pass earlier checks? no, readImage returns false after allocation.
data[8:10]=(0).to_bytes(2,'big')
out=Path('/workspace/poc_zero_rows.rgb')
out.write_bytes(data)
print(out, data[:20].hex())
